about_the_game:
Team Fortress 2 Legacy is a free multiplayer mod of Team Fortress 2 built on better Source 1 engine. It not only revives the classic 2007 Team Fortress gameplay but also introduces new game modes.
Dive into the vibrant and colorful world of battle! Play solo or join a team!

We offer:

  • Enjoy lightning fast Deathmatch mode! A great way to blow off steam after work or school!

  • 4-team gamemode. Now you can play as Yellow (YLW) and Green (GRN) teams!

  • Enhanced third-person mode, a smoother way to use classic game mechanics!

  • Performance and stability enhancements (now even old MediaTek can handle it!)

  • Ability to create custom weapons and cosmetics.

  • A variety of graphical improvements.

  • We'll try to eliminate cheaters and bots.

Experience the rich and improved gameplay of Team Fortress 2 with classic features, improvements and cosmetics!
